:::{#def-image}
#### Image

The **image**
[@wikipedia_image_mathematics]
of a [function](#def-function) $f : A \to B$
is the set of values that $f$ actually takes:

$$f(A) \eqdef \set{f(a) : a \in A}$$

For a single element $a \in A$,
the value $f(a)$ is also called the **image of** $a$ under $f$.

:::
